integrated.unit: event (incident prediction propagated to member events)

split.strategy: Stage 2 hash of the Stage 3 correlation group key (source, rule, src_ip, dst_ip, proto, floor(ts/window)); uncorrelatable rows hashed individually

diagnostics.note: diagnostic ablations on the same test events; NOT the thesis conditions

pooled_event_model.macro_label_set: union of true and predicted classes (sklearn default)

enriched_event_model.macro_label_set: union of true and predicted classes (sklearn default)

duplicates.definition: test event whose exact event-feature vector also occurs among train events

alert_reduction_by_dataset.family_rule: IoT-23 = sources starting 'CTU-'; Bot-IoT = sources starting 'data_'

incident_majority_vote.rule: one vote per test incident; true = majority of its event labels, pred = majority of the condition's event predictions (ties: count desc, benign first, then alphabetical)

bootstrap.method: incident-clustered bootstrap: test incidents resampled with replacement, all events of a drawn incident included; both conditions use the same draws
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile confidence interval (2.5th / 97.5th percentiles of the replicates)
bootstrap.note: a percentile CI from a clustered bootstrap, NOT a significance test
